answer_budget.over_budget_policy: recorded as over_budget:true on the row; never truncated, never re-prompted, never dropped from scoring

answer_budget.system_prompt_addition: ANSWER BUDGET (bounded tier, fixture_version v2-bounded). Every answer is measured in words and the count is recorded, not truncated and not re-prompted. Budgets are per turn: at most 150 words on a work, plant, or repair turn; at most 400 words on a checkpoint or verify turn. Your own answer text is the only thing counted, and any code or log you quote inside the answer counts toward it. Give the result and the single line of evidence that establishes it; do not re-quote source you did not change, do not restate the plan, do not summarise earlier turns. At a checkpoint turn the grader compares your ENTIRE answer with the value it expects, so answer with the value alone: no units, no restated question, no commentary, unless the question asks for a phrase or a list. At a verify turn you must still name the test files you ran, their exit status, and every count the task asks for. If a fact does not fit the budget, cut narration, never the fact: an answer that omits a required fact to stay under budget has failed the task.
